title: CoreWeave adds 150 MW lease at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 (~$4B)

sources.quote: This new lease agreement with CoreWeave brings Applied Digital’s total anticipated contracted lease revenue to approximately $11B, which includes $7B in revenue from the initial two approximately 15-year leases executed in May of this year.

explain: CoreWeave signed a third long-term lease for another 150 megawatts at Applied Digital's North Dakota campus, bringing its total there to 400 megawatts. The ~$4 billion figure is derived: Applied Digital said total CoreWeave lease revenue rose to about $11 billion from the earlier $7 billion.
